content: Jisas ap bwan kiyaan ridi duw sipwutiydid.
Jisas jabiraar ata salin dakuw, suwulin araar vakiyid diki tip Kapanimaar.

Vakiykuw, alim kwadik, nuwukadiy duw ap lupwun ridi duw bayim takakuw, kariyadaad Jisasak. Jisas wukidil day samasam wukijibir tidiy di bwunak kidi duwaam sipwutiy-kidaad wakuw. Alik di ap lupwudi duwak ata wadid, “Wunadi nyan, minadiy vaal wun yibwiy-tuwadiy.”
Nuwukadiy God diki lo kalivadiy duw day daya mawulaam wadiy, “Agwa javik kidi duw atawa wanaad? Godak wajibaynaad.”
Jisas dayadiy mawul vikuw, ata wadidiy, “Agwa javik gwur atawa kupwarapa mawul tinadiygwur?
“Agwa jaava kakilkina wun kwurkwurik, aw gwur vikuw, ‘Ayiy’ wakigwura a javik. Kidi ap lupwudi duwak wakituwad, ‘Minadiy vaal yibwiy-tuwadiy,’ ay ‘Min arap. Rapikuw, minadi baay kwurkuw, min maay.’

“Wun gwurak simaka-kituwa wun, duw taakw dayadi Mwaam, ki kupwaam ap kwurtuwaal duw taakw dayadiy valik yibwiy-tuwkik.” Di ap lupwudi duwak ata wadid, “Wun minak watuwa, arap! Minadi baay kwurkuw, maay mina wiyaar.”
Rapikuw, adi duw diki wiyaar ata yad.
Abab a jaav vikuw, pitadiy. Pitakuw, ata wadiy, “Wa! Tayir nyan atawa maa vi. God duwak kwiydaal apa mwiya nimaala.” Wakuw, day gaba maaj sukwudiy Godak.
Jisas Matiyuwak wadid, “Wuna kwukib may.”
Jisas adi tip wapakuw, yitaay tidik, takis saan kwurdi duw, Matiyuw opis im ridik Jisas vidid. Jisas dikik ata waad, “Wuna kwukib may.” Wakuw wadid, Matiyuw rasikuw, diki kwukib yad.
Ginyir Jisas kikipaat kidik Matiyuw diki wiyaam, dikidiy kalivadidiy duwawa samasam takis saan kwurdiy duw, nuwukadiy vaal yidiy duw ab alim jabim ridiy.

Nuwukadiy Parasiy bapa duw day vikuw Jisas takis saan kwurdiy duw nuwukadiy vaal yidiy duwawa kikipaat kad. Dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak bas sidadiy, “Agwa javik di takis saan kwurnadiy duwawa vaal yinadiy duwawa kikipaat kinaad?”

Jisas daya maaj wukikuw, dayak ata wadidiy, “Giviyib kwurnadiy duw adika dokta ak yikwanadiy. Kip ti duw yiyi maa rav. Wun vaal yinadiy duwadiy danik yanadiwun dayak sugwiyaan kwurkuw, day dayadiy bwan dayadiy vaal kwiydakik. Atawa wun viyakita duwak maa yay. Ki God wadil maaj God diki lapa nyigaam rina. Di waad,

content.text: ‘Wunak animal kabaka jabim gwuradiy valik dayada taka-tikwa. Gwur yikuw, nuwukadiy duw takwak awuk.’

content: Gwur yin ki God wadil maaj liki maw maaj awuk.”
Jon baptais dikidiy kalivadidiy duw Jisasak bas sidaad dikidiy kalivadidiy duw daya Godak gaba maaj sukwudadi sukwak.

Jon Baptais kwiydi duw, dikidiy kalivadidiy duw Jisasak yakuw, wadaad, “Nyan, Jon Baptais kwiydi duw dikidiy kalivadidiy duw, Parasiy dayadiywa nuwukadiy nyaam kikipaat akis kikwanadiyan gaba maaj sukwuk Godak. Agwa javik minadiy kaliva-minadiy duw atawa kwurin maarnadiy?”

Jisas dayak wadidiy, “Kapa nyanugw, duw taakw kiradil nyi kikipaat akis kikwanadiy? Si wana? Di dayawa kwakuw, day rakarak tikuw, atawa maa kwar. Ginyir yadaak, day taakw kiradil duw kwurin karaykuw, dayadiy mawul pakwun nadaak, adiy kapa nyanugw kikipaat ki maa a nyaam.
“Duw akis jaba wapwiyim tina tap aw kwula wapwiy kwurkuw, tipatip a maa rav. Aw a kwula wapwiy karyakin yikuw, adi tap ata nima tikina.

“Duw akis meme likidi sip jaab tidaak, kwula wain kwurkuw, adi sipaam vagavag maa rav. Adi sip wain awa wulwul maa rav. Alik wutak-na aw sipawa wain kupwaraap tikina. Duw kwula wain kwula meme sipaam vagakwanadiy.” Jisas kidiy waya maaj kitika maaj mugwul dayak wadidiy.
Kiyalil takwa nyinwa barik kwurlil taakw Jisas sipwutiy-dibir.

Jisas kidiy maaj watay tidik, Juw daya gaba maja wiya kidi sapakwa duw Jisasak yakuw, diki manwa vakirkuw, ata wadid, “Wuna kwasa takwa nyan bwutaay kiyana wayab. Aw min yakuw, lim taab takamin, rasilikik.”
Aw Jisas rasikuw, diwa yidik, Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw nakamwiyib yidiy.

Taakw nak waany wakwun tiya-lidiy nabiy tabatiy maan vitiy. Aw liki mawulaar ata waal, “Li wun taab dikidi wapwiy dikinim wapwa-kituwa, wun ata yara tikinawun.” Liki mawul warlik, Jisas yitaay tidik, li diki kwukir yakuw, Jisas dikidi wapwiyim ata tabaar kwasa kwasa yakitaay, wapwalid.
Wapwalik, Jisas tipatiyakwukuw, lim vikuw, ata wadil, “Wuna takwa nyan, yaga-tikwa. Nyin wunak wukijibir tinyinalik, alik nyina giviyib bwu kwusina.” Ata wadik, a taakw liki giviyib ata bwu kwusil.
Aw Jisas gaba maja wiya kidi sapakwa nyan diki wiyaar yin warkuw, vididiy samasama duw taakw, nuwukadiy kaany kwudiy, nuwukadiy giradiy. Alik pipiliy samasam takadiy.
Vikuw, Jisas ata wadidiy, “Gwur abab awap kawaar! Kwasa nyan li maa kiy. Li kip si kwana!” Atawa wadik, day abab wajikuw, wajibaydiy dikik.
Adiy duw taakw kawaar wayakidik, wakwudaak, Jisas kwasa nyan kwalil tamiyaar wulakuw, liki tabaam kaykitidik, li ata rasil.
A tamiyaam kwadiy duw taakw abab ata wukidaal a javik.
Jisas mil kwakibir kuw vitiy sipwutiydibir.
Jisas a wiy wapakuw, yitaay tidik, mil kwakibir duw vitiy diki kwukir yibir. Yikuw, Jisasak gaam sibir, “Min nyanadi warag dayadi yitaypika duw Davit dikidi gwalugwa duw-adimin. Anak awuk!”
Jisas yala wiyaar wuladik, abir duw ata yabir dikik. Yabir, birakik bas sidibir, “Bir bira mawulaar wukijibir tinabirbirik wun birabir mil sipwutiy-tuwkik?” “Ayiy, yitaypika duw,” wabirid.
Jisas birakibir milaam wapwakuw, wadibir, “Bir wunak wukijibiran tibiralik, alik ki jaav wukibira pik tikina.”
Wakuw, wadik, jayib nak ata birabir mil mwiyir vibirbir. Jisas ata nimadib wadibir, “Ki birak kwurtuwa jaav nuwukadiy duw takwak wawayik!”
Ata wadik, Jisasaam wapakuw, abir duw abab a tamiyaam kwadiy duw takwak wasapwiy-biril a javik.
Jisas duw mawulaam ridi wudib kwurin yakidik, adi duw ata maaj bas bwulaad.
Abir duw wapakuw yibir, nuwukadiy duw taakw duw kwurin Jisasak kariyadaad. Wudib adi duw diki mawulaar yidilik, alik maaj akis bwulakwaad.

Jisas adi wudib kwurin yakidik, adi duw ata maaj bas bwulaad. Ababa duw taakw a jaav vikuw, pitaan wardiy. Warkuw, awarwa awarwa bas sitaay, ata wadiy, “Nyan kitampika jaav tayir van maa ti Yisrayil jaka tipaam!”
Aw adiy Parasiy bapa duw ata wadiy, “Satan dikik ap kwiydalik, alik kidiy kupwarapa wudib kwurin yakididiy.”
Jisas duw takwak wukididiy.

Aw Jisas ata miyawa nimadiy tipawa kwasadiy tipaar yad. Yikuw, Juw dayadiy gaba maja wiyaam maaj wasapwiydil God dikidi duw takwak van tikida nyak. Adiy niki giviyib niki giviyib kwurdiy duw taakw adiy duw taakw dayadiy amwiy kupwaraap-adiy, sipwutiy-didiy.
Jisas duw taakw samasam vikuw, dayadiy mawul jawjaay tidaak, di samasam wukid dayak. Di wukidil, day duw van ti maardadiy sipsip kaytik, day jawjaay yin yaan tidiy miyawa tamiyaam.
Wukikuw, Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duwak wadidiy, “Samasama kikipaat bwutaay rawnadiy mayim. Aw dayaam yin kwurin kariya duw maa.
“Aw alik gwur bas as adi maay duwak di duw wayakidikik adiy kamnaagw vagaruwtaka-dakik. Aw God wukikuw, duw wayakidik yikuw, duw taakw samasam kupwaraap ti maa.”
